independence_declaration.statement: This qa-verifier run authored no product implementation in the DG5 scope. The P5 product was written by the implementer roles listed (D-155 to D-188). Round 4 reviews the same candidate as round 3 (D-189), and nothing in it has changed. The two findings I judge here, F-DG5-145 and F-DG5-146, are my own round-3 findings, so I am their reporting specialist. Their subjects (apps/web/e2e/p4-benefits.spec.ts and apps/web/e2e/session-end.spec.ts) were written by frontend-ux-engineer, not by me. This round I wrote only evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/round-4/, one probe spec under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/tests/round-4/ (outside the candidate; copied into the disposable clone only for its run and removed before the end-of-review identity check) and these review files. Every build and test ran in a disposable complete clone under $TMPDIR, which is now removed. I formed my verdict without reading any other reviewer's or the auditor's round-4 or round-5 records or assignments. The untracked docs/delivery/assignments/DG5/round-4/release-auditor.md and round-5/ were present, and I did not open them.

checks_run.expected: Test 8 passes with its assertions, and its duration is load-dependent and not caused by a slow product step. Accept as an observation only if the finding is Low, test-only, fail-safe and outside every DG5 acceptance text.
checks_run.actual: Run this round. Run 1: 28 passed, EXIT 0, with no failure, flake, skip or 'did not run'. Test 8 took 16.7 s en and 15.5 s ar. Loaded run: 9 passed, EXIT 0, and test 8 took 23.7 s en, 42 % slower under contention. Cited from round 3 (same candidate): 25.8/25.7 s alone at load about 8, and 30.2 s, the timeout, in the loaded full suite, where no assertion failed and the longest step was 1.53 s. The duration is the length of the chain: 9 axe scans, 11 full-page screenshots and two viewport sweeps on the default 30 s budget. The product is correct in every run: the auditor sees the read-only state and no create, decide or amend control; no page-level overflow at 390 px or 200 %; axe passes in en and ar. A timeout is a FAIL, never a false pass. Its requirement, REQ-PB-075, is a DG4 row, so no DG5 acceptance text is affected. Judgement: ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION (Low, not mandatory, not blocking), carried to DG6 as a fix: an explicit budget with at least 2x headroom, or a split, plus the D-189 sweep of the default-budget specs.

checks_run.procedure: Judge F-DG5-146 adversarially. Reproduce the race deterministically with my spec zz-qa-dg5rg4-session-race.spec.ts (outside the candidate; copied into the clone only for the run). R1 holds My Work's first GET /api/v1/me/work-items for 2.5 s, signs in, signs out elsewhere, then releases it; it asserts the product's session-end landing and that the original click target is gone. R2 uses the same hold, waits for the load to settle before signing out, and runs the original steps and assertions. Re-run the unmodified session-end.spec.ts alone, read the My Work load code, and check the requirement's gate.
checks_run.command: cp docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/tests/round-4/e2e/zz-qa-dg5rg4-session-race.spec.ts $TMPDIR/review-r4/apps/web/e2e/; scripts/run-e2e.sh unset 26610 26611 race product apps/web/e2e/zz-qa-dg5rg4-session-race.spec.ts; (session-end.spec.ts in the run of QA-RG4-02)
checks_run.environment: Clone $TMPDIR/review-r4 at 54e02b6; real stack (with-stack.sh, AUTH_MODE=dev); pre-installed Chromium; --workers=1; locale unset; ports 26610/26611; load median 0.69.
checks_run.expected: R1: the forced race reproduces the round-3 failure mode while the product lands once on sign-in with the localized message (returnTo=/my-work), with no loop and no stale shell, in en LTR and ar RTL. R2: with the precondition established, the original assertions pass unchanged. The unmodified spec passes alone. Accept only if the finding is Low, test-only, fail-safe and outside every DG5 acceptance text.
checks_run.actual: Run this round. Probe: 4 passed (R1 7.1 s en / 7.1 s ar; R2 7.5 s en / 7.6 s ar), EXIT 0, with no failure, flake or skip. R1: signIn() returned while the work-items request was held. After the logout, the app itself landed on /login?error=session_expired&returnTo=/my-work with the localized alert and dir rtl or ltr. The URL stayed on /login for 3 s, there were at most 3 further GET /me, no stale shell, no 429, and at least one work-items 401. The original test's navigation link had count 0, which is the round-3 failure made deterministic. R2: the original steps passed with returnTo=/transformations and 0 work-items 401s, so the fix direction needs no product change. The unmodified session-end.spec.ts passed 14/14 alone (QA-RG4-02 run; 'signed out in another tab' 5.1 s en / 5.2 s ar). A race makes the test FAIL, never falsely pass. Its requirement, REQ-S16-030, is a DG6 SPECIFIED row, so no DG5 acceptance text is affected. Observation, not a finding: My Work eagerly fetches every page of open work items (useMyWorkItems -> fetchAllPages, apps/web/src/api/p4.ts l.310-316). That is DG4 behaviour and the reason the window grows with data, and it is a DG6 performance follow-up. Judgement: ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION (Low, not mandatory, not blocking), carried to DG6 as a fix of the test's precondition.
